trust_decision.summary: CR-supplied strings must not be able to leave their directive header or parameter line when the fluentd config text is generated; this is decided only at the write sites in FluentRender.RenderDirectives, which at the pinned commit interpolates directive name, tag, @type/@id/@label/@log_level and parameter name/value with no newline check and no quoting.

landing_point.why: It is the single line that splices a CR-controlled parameter value straight into the fluentd config text (`%s %s`, k, params[k]); an engineer reading only 'Fluentd configuration injection' starts at this raw fmt-style write, not at the template writers in pkg/resources/fluentd.

fix_sites.entry_point: LoggingReconciler.clusterConfigurationFluentd -> FluentRender.Render (fed by Logging, Fluentd, Flow, ClusterFlow, Output and ClusterOutput CRs)
fix_sites.module_kind: Go SDK library - fluentd config renderer (directive header and tag)
Go SDK library - fluentd config renderer (@id, @label, @log_level lines)
Go SDK library - fluentd config renderer (parameter name and value)
Go SDK library - new helpers validateFluentToken / escapeFluentValue used by the two write sites

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The uncovered writers take FluentdSpec fields of the cluster-scoped aggregator CR, which only a cluster admin (who can already run arbitrary pods) can set, and flowConfigOverride is documented as a raw troubleshooting override - so a solver can argue they are admin-only or intentional, unlike the namespace-scoped Flow/Output parameters in the advisory.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: JSON-encoded map and slice parameters (labels, namespace_labels, metrics_labels, namespaces, container_names) must stay raw and unquoted so fluentd's label_router parses them; a fix that quotes/escapes every value, or escapes '#' and '"' unconditionally, turns them into literal strings and breaks flow routing.

O6_input_shapes: parameter value containing \n or \r: wrapped in double quotes with backslash, double quote, newline, CR, tab and '#' escaped
parameter value with no newline: emitted unchanged (JSON maps/arrays, embedded quotes, spaces)
parameter name containing \n or \r: rejected with an error
structural tokens (directive name, @type, @id, @label, @log_level, tag) containing \n or \r: rejected with an error, since they cannot be quoted

O8_uncovered_routes.route:
fluentLogDestination is spliced into fluentlog.conf with fmt.Appendf (no newline check at all): a value such as 'null
  </match>
</label>
<match **>
  @type exec
  command id
</match>' closes the FLUENT_LOG block and opens a new match with an exec plugin, in a file included by fluent.conf
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: FluentdSpec is a cluster-admin-only field on the aggregator CR and defaults to 'null', so a solver can call it admin-level configuration rather than the tenant Flow/Output path the advisory describes
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package (pkg/resources/fluentd vs pkg/sdk/logging/model/render), 2 files from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: FluentdSpec logFormat/logLevel/rootDir/metrics.path/ignoreSameLogInterval/ignoreRepeatedLogInterval are rendered into input.conf through html/template, which preserves newlines (it only HTML-escapes < > & " '), so extra parameter lines land inside the dedicated <system>/<source> blocks; there is no newline validation
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: same cluster-admin-only FluentdSpec, and the html/template escaping of '<' makes full directive injection impossible, so it looks already handled
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different package; the template itself is pkg/resources/fluentd/config.go:33-81

O8_uncovered_routes.route: logging.spec.flowConfigOverride, when non-empty, replaces the whole rendered fluentd config with the raw string and never enters RenderDirectives
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: documented as 'a raw configuration string for troubleshooting purposes' (charts/logging-operator/README.md:80), i.e. a deliberate escape hatch
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: controller package vs the SDK render package

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the fluent-bit node-agent config is generated with text/template from the same CR values and escapes nothing
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: same reconcile layer and same authoring convention as pkg/resources/fluentd/configsecret.go; a maintainer adding an aggregator or node-agent option writes a template field, not a render-package parameter, so the escaping never reaches it

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the syslog-ng backend has a parallel renderer whose Literal() quotes strings, while StringList (:137-147) and ArrowMap (:150-158) splice raw strings
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the two backends are edited in the same PRs and quoting is re-implemented per type there, so a third backend or a new field type is a natural place for the same mechanism to reappear

O8b_injection_room.sibling: every plugin directive is built by NewFlatDirective through the reflection mapper, so any new output/filter field becomes a Params entry one line from the sink
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: adding a plugin field requires no renderer change, and a field that legitimately wants multi-line text would have to bypass the new newline rejection

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject newlines in parameter values at RenderDirectives (or quote everything there) and stop, leaving the FluentdSpec template writers in pkg/resources/fluentd, the raw flowConfigOverride, and the raw-map parameters untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: pkg/resources/fluentbit/configsecret.go:508-528 builds the fluent-bit (node agent) config with text/template and no escaping: the same class of flaw but a different daemon and sink, so it is not scored here.

pkg/sdk/logging/model/syslogng/config renders syslog-ng config and mostly quotes via render.Literal (pkg/sdk/logging/model/syslogng/config/render/helpers.go:123-135), but leaves StringList/ArrowMap raw: different sink, not pursued.
